ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AEGIS LOGISTICS LIMITED has received a demand order from the Deputy Commissioner of Sales Tax, Maharashtra, imposing a penalty of Rs. 1,162,128 for the disallowance of Input Tax Credit (ITC). The company asserts this penalty will have no material financial or operational impact and intends to appeal the order before the appropriate authority. While the monetary impact is deemed non-material by the company, this disclosure highlights a regulatory challenge concerning tax compliance.
